title: CI-driven timestamped artifact release orchestrator for onboarding + profile publishing
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build a reproducible CI/CD flow that produces timestamped model artifacts with cryptographic attestation, attaches performance profiles, and supports atomic promotion and safe rollback. This pipeline should be usable for hosted, dedicated, and private onboarding flows and produce deterministic manifests that the runtime and registry can consume for pinning and canary releases. Key constraints: must integrate with KMS/HSM for signing, support staged promotion (canary -> ramp -> global), verify reproducible builds and perf regressions before promotion, and emit audit-ready provenance metadata. The outcome should reduce manual steps in current onboarding, eliminate ambiguous promotion windows, and reduce incidents caused by mismatched artifacts and profiles.
acceptance_criteria: CI produces a hermetic artifact bundle (.tar.gz) including model weights, repo hash, build environment spec, and perf profile.json; bundle filename includes UTC timestamp and deterministic hash
Artifact is cryptographically signed using customer/KMS key (or Redwood key in hosted path) and signature uploaded to artifact registry
Automated perf verification job compares new perf profile against baseline on representative workload; pass/fail gates promotion if regression > configurable threshold
Promotion process can perform canary routing for 1% of traffic, monitor error/latency/cost metrics for 24h, then auto-ramp or rollback based on SLOs
Model registry entry created with pinned version metadata and immutable manifest; pinned version referenced by release channel names (canary/stable)
Audit logs including who triggered release, artifact provenance, and signature metadata are stored for 7 years in compliance bucket
Manual override for immediate rollback that re-pins previous stable manifest within 5 minutes and triggers postmortem workflow
implementation_plan: Step 1: Extend existing build job to emit deterministic manifest and timestamped artifact filename (CI image pinning, env capture)
Step 2: Add signing step that calls KMS/HSM via short-lived credentials; store signature in registry alongside artifact
Step 3: Perf verification job: run representative evals in isolated runner, collect latency/cost/quality metrics, produce perf_profile.json
Step 4: Promotion orchestrator: implement canary rollouts, monitor via console metrics API, and execute automated rollback based on alert rules
Step 5: Registry integration: on successful promotion, create pin entry and broadcast to routing layer; support TTL-based pin rotation
Step 6: Observability: wire audit logs, provenance metadata, and create per-release dashboard template
Step 7: Docs & runbook: onboarding guide for model teams, rollback playbook, and security review notes
risks: Signing keys need strict access controls; any leak will require full artifact re-rotation
Perf eval runners must be representative; false positives/negatives could block or allow bad releases
Promotion automation could inadvertently ramp a faulty model if metrics ingestion is misconfigured
qa_plan: Unit tests for manifest generator and file naming determinism
Integration test that simulates a full CI run including signing against a test KMS and verifies registry pin creation
Staging canary run against synthetic 0.5% traffic with chaos tests (latency injection, partial KV cache loss)
Security review and pen test of signing path and credentials handling
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Feature branch validation and review (internal only)
Phase 1: Enable pipeline for internal test-models and dry-run promotions (no registry pinning)
Phase 2: Enable canary promotions for non-critical models with automated rollback enabled
Phase 3: Gradually onboard external partner models and enable full pinning for hosted catalog
notes: Decided to include UTC timestamp and a separate deterministic content-hash to allow fast diffing while preserving chronological ordering
Prefer KMS-backed signing with ephemeral creds; fallback to software signing only for air-gapped private installs
Perf thresholds will be configurable per-model-family; default: latency +5% OR quality drop >1% blocks promotion
